newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Lion Nathan sees brighter second half.
newsitem.headline: Lion Nathan sees brighter second half.

text.p: Lion Nathan Ltd chief executive Douglas Myers said on Monday the Australasian brewing and beverage company was optimistic it would show a stronger second half.

"There are encouraging signs that beer market share is stabilising in Australia, where the company has substantially restructured its operations and rejuvenated sales and marketing capability," chief executive Douglas Myers said.
Lion earlier reported a 20.8 percent decline in net earnings to NZ$72.2 million in the six months to February, a result that was slightly above expectations.
"Our new organisation structure in Australia and New Zealand gives us the best of both worlds - national strategic direction in support of strong brands," Myers said.
Myers said there were attractive growth prospects in China, with the potential to substantially boost cash flows once the Suzhou development phase is complete.
